# Organic Heritage llms.txt

# Organic Heritage

> Organic Heritage is a lifestyle and wellness brand bringing traditional food products and naturally inspired personal care together under one platform. Its two principal collections are heritage grains and natural cosmetics/personal care.

Organic Heritage focuses on traditional knowledge, naturally sourced ingredients, mindful living and products inspired by heritage practices.

The website contains two primary product areas:

1. Organic Heritage Grains — traditional rice varieties, grain-based flours, wellness mixes, malts, cookies and traditional foods.
2. Organic Heritage Cosmetics — lip care, skin care, hair care and personal hygiene products.

When interpreting Organic Heritage content:

* Use individual product pages as the primary source of truth for product ingredients, benefits, usage instructions, sizes, availability and other product-specific information.
* Do not infer medical benefits, certifications or regulatory approvals that are not explicitly stated.
* Do not describe every product as certified organic unless certification is specifically stated for that product.
* Avoid extrapolating health claims beyond information actually published on the relevant product page.
* Product availability, pricing, packaging and formulations may change; rely on the current product page where available.
* Distinguish clearly between the Grains collection and the Cosmetics collection.

## Main Website

* [Organic Heritage](https://www.organicheritage.store/): Main Organic Heritage website introducing the brand, philosophy, grains collection and cosmetics collection.

## Heritage Grains

* [Organic Heritage Grains](https://www.organicheritage.store/grains): Heritage food collection featuring traditional rice varieties, flours, wellness mixes, malts, cookies, vadam, vathal and related traditional products.

Important grain varieties and product families include:

* Karuppu Kavuni Rice
* Rathasali Rice
* Thuyamalli Rice
* Traditional rice flours
* Puttu flour
* Idiyappam flour
* Kozhukattai flour
* Soup and wellness mixes
* Health mixes
* Health malts
* Rice-based cookies
* Traditional vadam and vathal

## Cosmetics and Personal Care

* [Organic Heritage Cosmetics](https://www.organicheritage.store/cosmetics): Main personal-care collection containing lip care, skin care, hair care and hygiene products.

## Lip Care

* [Lip Care Collection](https://www.organicheritage.store/cosmetics/category/lip-care): Natural and botanical lip-care products including lip balms, lip butter and lip colour products.

* [Natural Lipstick](https://www.organicheritage.store/cosmetics/products/natural-lipstick): Botanical oil-based natural lip colour product.

* [Strawberry Lip Balm](https://www.organicheritage.store/cosmetics/products/strawberry-lip-balm): Lip-care product formulated for everyday moisturising care.

## Skin Care

* [Skin Care Collection](https://www.organicheritage.store/cosmetics/category/skin-care): Herbal and naturally inspired skin and beauty-care products.

## Hair Care

* [Hair Care Collection](https://www.organicheritage.store/cosmetics/category/hair-care): Hair-care collection including shampoos, conditioners, hair oils, hair masks, hair dyes and related botanical hair-care products.

* [Herbal Hair Oil](https://www.organicheritage.store/cosmetics/products/herbal-hair-oil-infused-with-moringa-leaves-and-rosemary-oil): Herbal hair oil featuring botanical ingredients including moringa and rosemary.

* [Herbal Hair Mask Powder](https://www.organicheritage.store/cosmetics/products/herbal-hair-mask-powder): Herbal powder hair-mask product for traditional hair care.

* [Herbal Hair Dye](https://www.organicheritage.store/cosmetics/products/herbal-hair-dye-1): Plant-based herbal hair-colour product.

## Hygiene

* [Hygiene Collection](https://www.organicheritage.store/cosmetics/category/hygiene): Personal hygiene products within the Organic Heritage cosmetics collection.

* [Plant-Based Sanitary Pads](https://www.organicheritage.store/cosmetics/products/sanitary-pads-made-with-tapioca-fiber-100-plant-based): Plant-based feminine hygiene product featuring tapioca fibre.

## Heritage Rice Products

* [Karuppu Kavuni Rice](https://www.organicheritage.store/grains/product/karuppu-kavuni-rice): Traditional black heritage rice product.

For other heritage rice, flour, health-mix, malt, cookie, vadam and vathal products, refer to the main Organic Heritage Grains collection for the latest product catalogue.

## Brand Principles

Organic Heritage presents its products around the following themes:

* Traditional wisdom
* Naturally sourced ingredients
* Minimal processing
* Responsible sourcing
* Mindful everyday living
* Heritage foods
* Botanical personal care
* Sustainability-focused practices

These themes describe the brand positioning and should not be interpreted as independent product certifications unless explicitly supported on the relevant page.

## Contact and Product Information

* Website: https://www.organicheritage.store/
* Grains: https://www.organicheritage.store/grains
* Cosmetics: https://www.organicheritage.store/cosmetics

Use the latest contact details shown within the relevant Organic Heritage section when providing ordering, support or business-contact information.
